b8.zh: T 方快攻占 14%，低于其他队伍的 29%，较少以快节奏直接发起进攻。
b8.en: The T side fast-hits in 14% of rounds versus the other teams' 29%, showing less reliance on quick attacks.

betboom.zh: BETBOOM 的 T 方快攻占 50%，高于其他队伍的 26%。最常用警家烟和甜甜圈出口烟爆弹 A 点，6 次赢下 5 次。
betboom.en: BETBOOM's T side fast-hits in 50% of rounds versus the other teams' 26%. Its go-to A execute uses CT smoke and Donut exit smoke, winning 5 of 6 attempts.

falcons.zh: Falcons 的 T 方最常用 A 点爆弹，以警家烟、A后点火（靠墓地）配合，4 次进攻赢下 1 次。CT 默认站位 A1 M2 B2 占 27% 的枪局，胜率 67%。
falcons.en: Falcons' T side favors an A execute with CT smoke and Back A molotov (Temple side), winning 1 of 4 attempts. The default CT setup A1 M2 B2 covers 27% of gun rounds with a 67% win rate.

fut-esports.zh: FUT Esports 的 T 方最常用 A 点爆弹，以警家烟、A后点火（靠墓地）配合，4 次进攻赢下 2 次。最常由 Krabeni 摸边，5 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
fut-esports.en: FUT Esports' T side favors an A execute with CT smoke and Back A molotov (Temple side), winning 2 of 4 attempts. The usual lurker is Krabeni, with him on the other side or away from the hit on 5 attacks.

g2.zh: T 方最常用 B 点爆弹，以一道烟、二道烟、B点柱子火配合，5 次进攻赢下 0 次。
g2.en: The T side favors a B execute with B short smoke, B long smoke and B pillar molotov, winning 0 of 5 attempts.

gamerlegion.zh: GamerLegion 的 CT 方堆点防守占 30%，高于其他队伍的 7%。默认站位 A2 B3 占 26% 的枪局，胜率 50%，更常集中人手守点。
gamerlegion.en: GamerLegion's CT side stacks in 30% of rounds versus the other teams' 7%, more often concentrating defenders at a site. Its default setup A2 B3 covers 26% of gun rounds with a 50% win rate.

lgcy.zh: LGCY 的 CT 默认站位 A2 B3 占 29% 的枪局，胜率 70%。
lgcy.en: LGCY's default CT setup A2 B3 covers 29% of gun rounds with a 70% win rate.

lvg.zh: LVG 的 T 方最常用一道烟、二道烟和 B点柱子火爆弹 B 点，4 次赢下 2 次。CT 堆点防守占 25%，高于其他队伍的 8%。
lvg.en: LVG's go-to T execute hits B with B short smoke, B long smoke and a B pillar molotov, winning 2 of 4 attempts. Its CT side stacks in 25% of rounds versus the other teams' 8%.

m80.zh: T 方最常用 A 点爆弹，以警家烟、甜甜圈出口烟配合，4 次进攻赢下 1 次。CT 默认站位 A2 B3 占 25% 的枪局，胜率 88%。
m80.en: The T side favors an A execute with CT smoke and Donut exit smoke, winning 1 of 4 attempts. The default CT setup A2 B3 covers 25% of gun rounds with an 88% win rate.

mibr.zh: MIBR 的 T 方有摸边的进攻占 58%，高于其他队伍的 36%。最常用警家烟和靠墓地的 A后点火爆弹 A 点，7 次赢下 3 次。
mibr.en: MIBR's T side includes a lurker on 58% of hits versus the other teams' 36%. Its go-to A execute uses CT smoke and a Back A molotov on the Temple side, winning 3 of 7 attempts.

nrg.zh: NRG 的 T 方最常用 B 点爆弹，以二道烟、一道火（深）配合，4 次进攻赢下 3 次。
nrg.en: NRG's T side favors a B execute with B long smoke and B short molotov (deep), winning 3 of 4 attempts.

parivision.zh: PARIVISION 的 T 方有摸边的进攻占 56%，高于其他队伍的 36%。最常用警家烟和靠墓地的 A后点火爆弹 A 点，5 次赢下 4 次。
parivision.en: PARIVISION's T side includes a lurker on 56% of hits versus the other teams' 36%. Its go-to A execute uses CT smoke and a Back A molotov on the Temple side, winning 4 of 5 attempts.

sinners.zh: SINNERS 的 T 方最常由 kisserek 摸边，4 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
sinners.en: SINNERS' T side usually has kisserek lurking, with him on the other side or away from the hit on 4 attacks.

the-mongolz.zh: The MongolZ 的 T 方最常用 B 点爆弹，以一道烟、二道烟、B点柱子火配合，4 次进攻赢下 3 次。
the-mongolz.en: The MongolZ's T side favors a B execute with B short smoke, B long smoke and B pillar molotov, winning 3 of 4 attempts.

tyloo.zh: TYLOO 的 T 方最常用 B 点爆弹，以一道烟、二道烟、B点柱子火配合，9 次进攻赢下 6 次。
tyloo.en: TYLOO's T side favors a B execute with B short smoke, B long smoke and B pillar molotov, winning 6 of 9 attempts.
